name: message-scroller
title: Message Scroller
description: A conversation's scroll area that stays on the newest message and offers a Jump to latest pill when you scroll up.
usage: Wrap a conversation in MessageScroller with MessageScrollerViewport, MessageScrollerContent and one MessageScrollerItem per message, and add MessageScrollerButton for the jump pill. Set scrollAnchor on the message just sent so its reply grows below it. useMessageScroller, useMessageScrollerScrollable and useMessageScrollerVisibility read and drive it; MessageScrollerProvider lets a composer outside the scroll area reach it.
avoid: Auto-scrolling while someone reads older messages

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
